text: dsh-tinyfish 是将 TinyFish 接入 DSH 网页搜索与网页抓取的插件。它向 DSH 的 web 能力注册搜索和抓取 provider，并让 web 配置选用 TinyFish；原有 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具仍由 DSH 提供。用户可通过搜索查询获得网页来源，也可抓取指定网址并返回文本内容，适合希望替换 DSH 搜索和抓取后端的场景。使用前需要 TinyFish API key，运行时从 DSH_HOME/tinyfish.key 读取。

dsh-tinyfish connects TinyFish to DSH web search and fetch by registering providers on DSH’s web capability. Search returns web sources for a query, while fetch returns text from a requested URL. An API key is required; the provider reads it from DSH_HOME/tinyfish.key.
让 DSH 用 TinyFish 搜索网页并返回搜索结果。
想让 DSH 抓取指定网址的正文文本。
Route DSH web search and page fetching through TinyFish.
dsh-tinyfish 的功能「网页搜索与抓取」：将 DSH 的搜索和抓取 provider 指向 TinyFish。搜索接收查询并返回网页 URL、标题、摘要和日期；抓取接收网址并返回文本正文。
dsh-tinyfish 使用前须知：需提供 TinyFish API key，运行时从 DSH_HOME/tinyfish.key 读取。（见 provider/index.mjs:26-35）
dsh-tinyfish 使用前须知：查询发送到 api.search.tinyfish.ai，目标网址发送到 api.fetch.tinyfish.ai。（见 provider/index.mjs:85-95、113-124）

@local/dsh-tinyfish-mcp README · Or do it yourself：Get a free key at <https://agent.tinyfish.ai/api-keys>, then:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/gg686-jkl/dsh-tinyfish.git
cd dsh-tinyfish
node install.mjs --key sk-tinyfish-xxxx
```

No git (usual on a phone):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://codeload.github.com/gg686-jkl/dsh-tinyfish/tar.gz/refs/heads/main | tar xz
cd dsh-tinyfish-main && node install.mjs --key sk-tinyfish-xxxx
```

Restart dsh and open a **new session**. Search and fetch now go through TinyFish.

@local/dsh-tinyfish-mcp README · FAQ：**What about browser automation or deep research?** TinyFish charges for those, so they are not mounted
by default. `node install.mjs --key … --with-mcp` adds them as `mcp__tinyfish__*` tools.

**Why not just use the TinyFish MCP server for everything?** Its tools get namespaced
(`mcp__tinyfish__search`) and use different schemas, so a model that knows `web_search` has to relearn
them. With the official tools, nothing changes for the model.

@local/dsh-tinyfish-mcp README · Notes：- Requires dsh ≥ 0.2, and nothing else to install.
- The key lives in `$DSH_HOME/tinyfish.key` (mode 600) and never enters YAML.
- Your profile points at this directory, so keep it where you cloned it. If you move it, re-run
  `node install.mjs --force`.
- Need TinyFish's advanced fetch parameters (`format`, CSS selectors, 10 URLs at once) or automation and
  research in the same session? Use `--with-mcp`; TinyFish bills those per use.
